                                                       【About Astellas】 Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. （HP：Learn more about Astellas） Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients? We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.   【募集の背景 / Purpose & Scope】  Oncology Researchでは、創薬初期段階における意思決定の質を高めるため、探索安全性（Exploratory Safety）の機能強化を進めています。本募集では、安全性研究の専門性を活かしながら、早期創薬プロジェクトチームの一員として成長・活躍していただけるサイエンティストを求めています。 本ポジションの所属は Formulation & ADME ユニットですが、役割の中心は Oncology Researchの early stage drug discovery programs における毒性スクリーニング及び安全性評価です。 探索安全性の専門性を基盤としつつ、有効性・動態・フォーミュレーションと並行して安全性を議論し、創薬初期の検討や意思決定に貢献する役割を担っていただきます。 Oncology Research is strengthening its exploratory safety capability to enhance the quality of decision making in early drug discovery. We are seeking a scientist who will contribute to early stage project teams and grow into a broader role, leveraging expertise in exploratory safety to help advance oncology drug discovery programs.  While the home department for this role is Formulation & ADME, the day to day mission is to work closely with Oncology Research early stage discovery teams, bringing an exploratory safety perspective into key scientific discussions and decisions. The role goes beyond executing assigned studies; you will provide scientific input, connect data to decisions, and progressively expand your impact across projects.       【職務の内容 / Essential Job Responsibilities】  （雇入れ直後）  ・Act as a member of the early-stage project team. ▷
